To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
translational science is the process of making environmental science understandable and usable by stakeholders.
translational environmental science can be defined as a set of 53 skills that are organized into 7 categories and that can be developed through a community of practice.

translational research in the field of environmental science requires a set of skills, content areas and dispositional attributes, which can be taught to doctoral students using a set of instructional activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a framework for training translational environmental scientists.
how to train doctoral students to be effective translational scientists.
the development of a pedagogy for training translational environmental science researchers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
translational science in environmental science can be achieved through a comprehensive pedagogic approach that builds a community of practice.

the translational science competencies and pedagogical approaches identified in this project will help train tomorrow’s environmental scientists to be translational and will help to build an environmental science community of practice whose work enhances social ecological resilience.
translational science is the application of scientific knowledge and methods to address real-world problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are developing a pedagogy for translational environmental science.

we are developing a pedagogical model for doctoral training to produce translational scientists who can effectively communicate with a broad range of stakeholders to improve environmental decision-making.
translational environmental science is a new way of conducting research and communicating results, with the goal of improving social-ecological systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
training for translational science should be a core component of graduate training in environmental science.
the skills, competencies, and dispositions that are required for translational research are best learned through experiential learning.
translational environmental science requires a broad range of skills and dispositions that are not currently emphasized in graduate training programs.
